mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly FEDFUNDS rate above the prior 12-month average predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to tightened discounting of future cash flows.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are non-negative in >70% of triggered events, or FEDFUNDS change is not statistically significant from zero.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly PAYEMS exceeds the 12-month moving average, labor market strength is interpreted as a positive demand signal, driving a 60-day S&P 500 forward return up.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >50% of triggered events, or PAYEMS growth is not statistically different from its mean.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly increases in HOUST (industrial production) above trend imply accelerating supply capacity, which is expected to suppress near-term S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >80% of triggered events, or HOUST growth is not statistically significant.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in INDPRO below its 6-month moving average suggests weakening manufacturing capacity, which should produce a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are non-negative in >50% of INDPRO < INDPRO_6M_avg periods.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4%, the decline in labor cost pressures is expected to boost investor confidence, yielding a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of UNRATE < 4.0 events.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly rises in GDPC1 (personal consumption) and RSAFS (retail sales) above their 3-month averages jointly predict a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return through stronger aggregate demand.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero in 80% of triggered events.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in UNRATE accompanied by a 10% drop in PAYEMS in the same window signals labor market stress, resulting in a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >70% of such events, or the correlation between UNRATE and PAYEMS drops below 0.5.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL (CPI) exceeds its 4-month moving average in a monetary easing regime, it suggests persistent inflation pressures that should produce a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are non-negative in >80% of triggered episodes.
